stories.title: Kang Yeon-seo wins women's individual bronze in compound archery

en.title: Kang Yeon-seo wins women's individual bronze in compound archery
en.summary: Kang Yeon-seo, 14, won bronze in women's individual compound archery at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, defeating fellow South Korean Park Jung-yoon. This was her second medal at the competition.

en.summary: South Korea and the United States selected a gas-fired power plant in Texas as the first project under Seoul's $350 billion investment commitment to the U.S., with the agreement linked to tariff reductions on Korean imports.

stories.title: Trump unveils 3 projects under Korea's $200b US investment plan

en.summary: President Trump revealed three specific projects from South Korea's $200 billion U.S. investment commitment: a Texas gas-fired power facility, eight nuclear reactors, and an Alaska LNG project review, part of a broader $350 billion investment package.
